covers: Checkout/payment, top-up, order lifecycle grouping, billing address, account deletion — the /account, /checkout, /profile areas.

checkout.flow: POST /bff/payments/intent {package_id} -> {data:{checkoutUrl}} -> window.location.assign(checkoutUrl) [Pokpay hosted checkout] -> src/app/checkout/return/route.ts handles the redirect back
checkout.auth_edge_case: 401 from the intent call redirects the browser to /signin?next=/checkout?package=<id> instead of showing an error
checkout.why_full_nav_not_popup: popups are unreliable in mobile and in-app browsers (design decision, see PayButton comment)

order_lifecycle.single_active_plan_rule: backend allows exactly one active plan at a time; GET /orders/active returns that ONE order (not a list) and, as a side effect of being called, expires a depleted plan server-side
order_lifecycle.resolveOrderSections_and_groupOrdersByLi: the active-order lookup is treated as authoritative over the full /orders list — it can demote a plan the list still calls active, or promote one the list hasn't caught up on; falls back to pure list-grouping if the active lookup fails
order_lifecycle.groupOrdersByLifecycle_details: active[] sorted newest-first, only the first kept as `active`, any surplus falls into `ready`; unknown/unrecognized lifecycle strings default to `ready` (never dropped) so a paid plan can't silently disappear from the UI
order_lifecycle.usage_fetching: per-order usage stats are fetched individually (one upstream call each); only the live/active plan's usage loads on the /account list page, others load on their own detail page (/account/[orderId])

topup.esim_pending_topup_cookie: value '<orderId>:<paymentId>' set at intent time; the provisioning response can't identify which eSIM was topped up (backend returns the provider's top-up record; the payment reference only decodes to an ICCID), so this cookie is the join key. Also doubles as a payment-id fallback if Pokpay's return omits one. Cleared on return and by buildClearedSessionCookies() on signout.
topup.route_ordering_note: Next resolves the static /account/topup segment before the dynamic /account/[orderId] segment

payment_failure_reporting.rule: only an upstream 402 is surfaced as reason=unpaid; every other failure (network, 5xx, timeout) is reported as reason=provisioning
payment_failure_reporting.why: a non-402 failure might have already captured the card, so the UI must not claim 'nothing was charged'

billing.card_details_status: PUT /user/card-details returns 410 Gone — saved cards are permanently disabled server-side; card entry only happens inside Pokpay's hosted checkout
billing.editable_fields: billing address only, via GET/PUT /user/billing-address; validation rules/messages owned by backend

account_deletion.retention_disclosure: UI is explicit that service records may be retained for payment, fraud, tax, and provider obligations
account_deletion.cookie_clear_timing: session cookies are cleared ONLY on successful deletion (a failed attempt must not strand the visitor outside a still-existing account)
account_deletion.post_delete_route: /profile/deleted is in UNGUARDED_PATHS — reached with the session already destroyed

single_live_order_gotcha: any UI or logic assuming a user can have multiple concurrently-active plans is wrong for this backend; it's enforced as exactly one.

promo_code.flow: apply/change UX ('Partner Code: XXXX ✓' + Change link) -> POST /bff/checkout/apply-promo {promoCode, packageId} -> backend POST /payments/apply-promo -> {applied:true, discountPct, finalCustomerPriceCents} or {applied:false}. Applied code persists to localStorage keyed by packageId and silently re-validates against the live endpoint on return visits — a transient failure during that re-check does NOT wipe the stored code, only a confirmed applied:false does.
promo_code.payment_intent_wiring: PayButton's POST /bff/payments/intent now threads promoCode through as promo_code on the wire, forwarded to the backend as camelCase promoCode, and OMITTED entirely (not sent as '') when no code is applied (f094).
promo_code.loading_gate: while an apply/re-validate call is in flight, price display shows a loading state (no full-price flash) and PayButton is disabled — closes a gap where a customer could pay at full price before a just-submitted promo code actually applied.
promo_code.interaction_with_admin_discount: unaffected: plan.hasDiscount/retailPrice is a different, admin-set retail-discount mechanism baked into plan.price. Once a promo is applied, the displayed total becomes the backend's finalCustomerPriceCents outright rather than being recomputed/stacked client-side.

conversion_tracking.component: src/app/GoogleTag.tsx (gtag.js loaded globally via next/script in the root layout) + src/app/account/[orderId]/PurchaseConversion.tsx (f095)
conversion_tracking.fires: a Google Ads 'conversion' event on the /account/[orderId]?new=1 checkout-confirmation view (the exact redirect target of checkout/return/route.ts on success), with transaction_id set to the order code; deduped per order via sessionStorage so a refresh of the confirmation URL doesn't double-count.
conversion_tracking.config: tracking id/label live in src/lib/analytics.ts, overridable via NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_ID / NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS_PURCHASE_LABEL, pinned explicitly in .env.production rather than relying only on the code fallback.
